name: dsh-crossnet-link
description: Persistent DSH plugin face of dsh-crossnet-link (the plugin display name is the package name): the plugins-page settings card that edits this link's own check parameters (settings.plugin.item, keyed by the dsh-crossnet-link settings namespace), plus a read-only HTTP route that runs the repository's read-only collector (src/collect.ps1 -CheckOnly -AsJson) with those stored parameters. The host half never edits a settings document directly - a one-time, per-key auto-fill of the machine-detectable fields (never overwriting existing values) and the card's saves both go through the platform settings service into the user's own settings - opens no listener, reads no credential material and changes no system setting. The loader row ships disabled: see plugin/cordis.patch.yml.
